outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of micrograph images (pseudocoloured confocal frames), not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B (and its insets) are scatter/line plots where each individual measured intensity value at each time point is directly plotted as a data point (red/green markers), with the fitted diffusion model shown as an overlaid solid line. Since the individual data points themselves are displayed rather than only a summary average, this satisfies the check (scatter/line-type plots are exempt from requiring an additional overlay since the points shown are already the individual measurements).
